project_type: Self-hosted SAML 2.0 + OAuth 2.0 identity provider; Flask app factory (create_app) with embedded HTML templates as triple-quoted strings; gunicorn in production (single worker by design).
build_system: setuptools via pyproject.toml; no compile step. Package: identity_provider_server. Entry points: identity-provider-server (__main__:main), run-idp (run_gunicorn:main).
test_framework: pytest. Markers: smoke, integration (declared in pyproject.toml [tool.pytest.ini_options]).
build_command: python -m build  (not normally needed; there is no compiled artifact).
verification_instructions: ALWAYS run `source /Users/topazb/python/py314/bin/activate` first. Then from the worktree root: `ruff check identity_provider_server/` (must be clean), `bandit -r identity_provider_server/ -q` (0 medium/high), `python -m pytest -q` (all pass), and for the final gate `python -m pytest --cov=identity_provider_server --cov-report=term-missing -q` (coverage must be 100%, pyproject fail_under=100). Baseline before changes: 657 passed, 28 skipped (~76s).
snapshot_or_generated_files: None generated by the build. BUT the test suite requires two gitignored fixtures in the worktree data dir that are absent in a fresh worktree: data/idp.key and data/users.json. These files are gitignored (.gitignore lists data/idp.key, data/users.json) and MUST NOT be committed.

Use `git -C /Users/topazb/repos/identity-provider/.worktrees/sec-f2-f5-medium` for git. Commit locally on branch security/20261006-f2-f5-medium; never push. contribution_requirements: Repo Python standards: from __future__ import annotations; full type hints; Google-style docstrings; snake_case; absolute imports; ruff line-length 100 (admin.py/app.py/totp.py exempt from E501 for embedded templates only). ruff lint select E,F,W,I,UP,B,SIM must pass. bandit clean at medium+. Every behavior change needs tests; add @pytest.mark.smoke for any new primary happy path. Coverage gate is 100% (fail_under=100), so every new line must be exercised.
key_patterns: Admin action forms POST hidden csrf_token + auth_token + action inputs (see ADMIN_PANEL template in admin.py ~line 180+). Sensitive admin renders wrap render_template_string in app.make_response(...) and set resp.headers['Cache-Control']='no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate, max-age=0' (admin.py lines 798,827,1517,1821). Fail-closed startup pattern: WeakSecretKeyError + _resolve_secret_key in app.py ~line 899-944. Session revocation epoch: app.py _user_session_epoch (~2018) reads user['session_epoch']; admin.py _bump_session_epoch (~635) increments it; app.py _bump_session_epoch_local (~3369) for self-service. OAuth JWT redirect sites in app.py: SSO short-circuit GET ~1512, MFA tail ~1715, password tail ~1930, passkey tail JSON ~2878 (all use f"{sp.url}{separator}token={token}"). SAML delivery uses SAML_POST template (auto-submitting POST form) at ~1527/1739/1966/2891 — leave unchanged. Config: config.py _DEFAULTS dict + per-dataclass fields + env_map (~line 175-194); loader coerces env values by the default's python type. Entry points __main__.py and run_gunicorn.py both build config via load_config then call create_app with explicit kwargs (host, port, secret_key, secure_cookies NOT currently threaded for trust_proxy). register_admin_routes (admin.py ~457) already receives data_dir: Path | None, users, users_path, save_users_fn, audit_logger.
